---
title: "History"
---

SEA-India was established by a group of practicing structural engineers who recognised the need for a dedicated professional organisation representing structural engineers across India.

The Association was formally registered on 15 November 2025 under the *Karnataka Societies Registration Act, 1960*, with its registered office in Hubballi, Karnataka.

Since its inception, SEA-India has focused on building a credible professional institution that encourages knowledge sharing, technical excellence, ethical practice, continuing professional development, and constructive engagement with government, academia, and industry.
